subject: Handoff: SprintZero orchestration & canary migration plan for NimbusHealth
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@nimbushealth.com>, NimbusHealth Integration Team <eng-team@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: SprintZero orchestration & canary migration plan for NimbusHealth

Hi Alex / Nimbus team —

Thanks again for signing. Welcome to Redwood. I’m looping in our Implementation and CS leads to start SprintZero and nail down a canary-forward migration that minimizes user impact. Attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short runbook with the proposed canary gates (sprint-zero-runbook.pdf).

High level proposal (SprintZero -> Canary -> Migration -> Training):
- SprintZero (Week 0–2): infra access, creds, test dataset ingest, readiness checklist. Owner: Laura.
- Canary Week (Week 3): small cohort routing to Redwood Dedicated pool, smoke tests, latency SLAs validated. Owner: Marissa + engineering liaisons.
- Migration (Week 4–5): staged rollout by tenant segment, fallback policy, DB migration window (2AM–6AM PT). Owner: Nimbus eng + Redwood ops.
- Training (Week 4 ongoing): ops runbook review, 2x 90m admin sessions, 1x train-the-trainer. Owner: Marissa.

Acceptance criteria we want to hit before full cutover:
- 99th percentile tail latency within agreed SLA for 95% of requests in canary cohort
- No data-loss incidents during migration rehearsal
- Training completed for on-call and platform admins

Open asks for the team to confirm in the next 48 hours:
1) Final list of service accounts + VPN whitelist for SprintZero (Alex)
2) Confirmation of the preferred migration weekend (we propose Aug 2–3)
3) Point of contact for change approvals during canary (name + mobile)

I’ll set a 30-min kickoff for Wed to walk through the MAP and owners.

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + task owners), sprint-zero-runbook.pdf (canary gates & rollback), canary-checklist.md (short checklist)

—
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: SprintZero orchestration & canary migration plan for NimbusHealth

Thanks Diego — quick detail pass from implementation side. I updated Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx with task-level owners and a lightweight timeline. Key notes:

SprintZero (days 1–10) tasks (owners):
- IAM & network access (Laura) — target Day 2 for service accounts and VPN rules
- Test dataset snapshot delivery (Nimbus) — requested by Day 3, we’ll validate ingestion Day 4
- Baseline performance run (Redwood infra) — Day 5, automated smoke tests

Canary (Day 15–17)
- Canary cohort definition: 5% of production traffic or 200 requests/min (whichever is lower)
- Canary gating: automated anomaly detection, manual stop on failed regression
- Rollback plan: immediate routing back to prior provider + cache flush steps documented

Migration (Week 4)
- Data migration rehearsal (dry-run) Saturday 2AM–4AM PT
- Final migration window Sunday 2AM–6AM PT (Aug 3 proposed)

Training / Ops knowledge transfer
- Two instructor-led sessions (90 min) booked: Aug 4 and Aug 6 — link to calendar invite will follow.
- Deliverables: runbook PDF + short playbook clip (DocSend link in related_links)

Risk notes & mitigations:
- Risk: long tail latency on larger payloads — Mitigation: temporary payload size cap + throttling rule during canary
- Risk: DB schema drift — Mitigation: schema compatibility check during rehearsal, rollback snapshot plan

I’ll attach the updated MAP and a condensed canary checklist to this thread. If Nimbus can confirm service accounts and the Aug 2–3 window, we’ll lock calendar invites and pre-provision capacity.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: NimbusHealth Integration Team <eng-team@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: SprintZero orchestration & canary migration plan for NimbusHealth

Marissa / Diego — thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from the Nimbus side before we lock dates: 
1) Service accounts: we will provide the list by EOD Thursday (17 Jul). Do you need specific public key formats for SSH or certs?
2) Migration weekend: Aug 2–3 looks feasible but we need to run it past our compliance window — I’ll confirm by Thu morning.
3) SOC2 / security evidence: our security team requested a short pack showing audit logs and network isolation controls for the Dedicated pool. Can you attach or point me to the SOC2 summary & architecture diagram?

Quick notes on canary sizing: we prefer an explicit tenant-based cohort rather than a % of traffic to minimize cross-tenant impact. If Redwood can route per-tenant at the edge, we’ll propose b2b-demo and pilot-accounts as the canary segment.

Alex — great, thanks for the quick responses. Per your request I’ve uploaded the SOC2 summary and the dedicated pool architecture diagram to the Drive link below and attached the short canary-checklist.md for your eng team.

Next steps (action owners & dates):
- Nimbus: deliver service account list + canary cohort tenant ids — by Thu 2025-07-17 (pending)
- Redwood (Laura): provision VPN whitelist and test accounts — by Tue 2025-07-22
- Redwood (Marissa): schedule baseline perf run and send results — by Fri 2025-07-25
- Joint: formal kickoff walkthrough — Wed 2025-07-23 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent)

Links & attachments: https://drive.example/redwood/Nimbus/MAP-v1 (SOC2_SUMMARY.pdf, dedicated-pool-arch.svg), canary-checklist.md (attached)

If the Aug 2–3 window is approved by Nimbus compliance, we’ll mark migration rehearsal for Aug 2 and final cutover Aug 3 (2AM–6AM PT). I’ll confirm capacity reservations once Nimbus confirms.

Thanks team — looking forward to a smooth run.
